Here’s what we know… {break} It lives in the **Muck**... {break} It **rarely** bites... {break} and it only bites if you're using **Spee-Dee Bait**{break} To make the bait you'll need this **Recipe for Blueprint: Angler's Table**. {break} Build an **Angler's Table**, bait up, and see if you can bag that **Spindly Puffermucker**!

Catch a Spindly Puffermucker with Spee-Dee Bait

Any luck reeling in that muck-monster?
Sweet scallops! I've got to tell the rest of the pond about this one!

You've shown me your dedication to the fishers of The Collective... {break} I'm proud of you. {break} I told my friend down in **Stoke** about you and they said they could use a keen angler like yourself for a project they're working on. {break} Keep your eyes on the water and your eye on your Robot, they'll be reaching out soon. {break} Before you go, take this **Tackle Box** for a place to store your rods, bait, and even a swimmer or two.

Dive for Ty's lost Diving Equipment
Did you find my diving equipment?

items.name: Busted
trigger: Well you've got the **Shell**, now you just need a **Motor** and a **Power Supply**. {break} Luckily, **Doc** runs the shipping routes south of here and usually has a **Robot Motor Unit** or two kicking around. {break} Head to Doc's Docks and see if you can get a **Robot Motor Unit** off of them.

Yo, yo, yo! I love seeing new faces around here! {break} I'm **Doc**, importer exporter extraordinaire. The Collective's go-to for whatever rare goods you need. {break} A **Robot Motor Unit** is what ya after? {break} I should have one or two laying around here... {break} How about this... {break} If you're willing to help us with some of the build projects around here I'll dig around for that **Robot Motor Unit** for ya.

Great! We're going to need a handful of **Logs** to put this place back together. {break} If you haven't noticed, most of the trees you come across have been infested with **Muck** and chopping them down doesn't get you much. {break} Shortly after the muckening one of our scientists crafted the first muck-cleansing **Muck Buster**. {break} There was a big shipment of **Muck Busters** coming in from Stoke when the boat got overran by muckfish and capsized. {break} Swim out and **search the sunken boat** for some of 'em.
Search the wreckage for some Muck Busters
Deliver the Water-logged Muck Buster to Doc
Ask Doc how to make Muck Busters

Yowee! How long has this thing been under water? {break} Well, I hate to break it to you, but I don't think this one is going to work. {break} Hmm... the construction actually looks pretty simple. {break} Go find **Huck** in the Muck and see if they can create a recipe from this for you...
Take back the Water-logged Muck Buster
Deliver the Water-logged Muck Buster to Huck
Huck is tha name, bustin' muck is my game! {break} What is this you've got here?
Give Huck the Water-logged Muck Buster
Ask Huck how to make Muck Busters

This thing has seen betta' days! {break} Let me take a quick look... {break} Yep this should be pretty simple to build yaself. {break} Ya might just need a few **Muckwad** and a little elbow grease... {break} Here, take this recipe and craft a few **Muck Busters** then come back to me and I'll show ya how to use 'em.

Bangin' job! {break} If this is ya first time **busting muck** there's a few things ya should know... {break} Underneath tha purple-y gurple-y gunk out there is tha lush, vibrant world we once lived in. {break} If ya place a **Muck Buster** out there it will temporarily cleanse any organic material of tha muck and bring ta life what was there before. {break} The Collective is always workin' on ways that we can clear the muck for good but for now these **Muck Busters** will allow us to gather the resources to begin rebuilding. {break} Speaking of... {break} Head out and find some purple trees, place a **Muck Buster** next to 'em, and grab a few logs... you'll need 'em to make some proper tools!
Use Muck Buster to clear the Muck
Place a Muck Buster near a tree in the Muck
Collect {count}/{countTarget} Logs from trees that have been cleansed by Muck Busters
Return to Huck with your logs

Booyah! Nice work out there bustin' and breakin'! {break} After ya **Muck Bust** those trees, ya can use an **Axe** to chop the logs even faster. {break} If ya don't already have one, let me suggest **handcrafting a Wooden Axe** and using that on any trees ya'v cleansed of tha mucky infestation!
Collect {count}/{countTarget} Oak Logs from cleansed Oak Trees
Were you able to gather any logs to help us rebuild?
Just what we need to fix this place up! {break} With so much splintered wood around here I think we better get you set up with a pair of shoes... {break} Take your pick!
Aaaaand before ya go... {break} Bingo bango bongo! Lookey what I found!

It's been great having you out here! {break} The Collective is full of people like you willing to roll their sleeves up and help out. {break} Jackie is probably wondering where you're at! {break} You're welcome back here any time, we've always got a handful of things to do around the docks.
**Robot Shell**... check! {break} **Robot Motor Unit**... check! {break} That only leaves one more part...

Come on over! The more fishers the merrier! {break} See this pond? Small, clear, and shallow right? {break} You won't find a 14-inch Muckfish swimming around in here but these tiny clearwater fish can still put up a fight! {break} This pond is a notorious spawning ground for the **Royal Gramma**, a small but elusive swimmer. {break} If you can bring a **Royal Gramma** back to Gil that should convince them that you're ready to start reelin' in the Muck.
What did you catch up there?

A Royal Gramma! Wow, I remember when I caught my first one of these. {break} Great memories... that was a different time. {break} Take this as a token of my appreciation. {break} If you don't have one already, these **Clearing Stones** can turn any mucked up fishing hole into crystal clear water!
Oh yeah! And I almost forgot... {break} I think a **Fishing Hat** is well deserved! Choose your favorite.

items.name: In Storage
trigger: We've been stockpiling supplies for those trekking up the mountain and last night some **Cobbled Mucklings** came through and destroyed our storage! {break} I could use a hand rebuilding some **Wood Chests** and I'll make it worth your while!
Visit Ol' Coop at Muckerhorn Basecamp

Well 'ello there {username}! Great to meet you in person. {break} As you saw in my transmission, some **Cobbled Mucklings** stormed down from Muckerhorn and laid waste to my storage! {break} To make **Wood Chests** we need the teeth from the cobbled capers. {break} Head up Muckerhorn and clobber a few of those Cobbled Mucklings then bring me back some **Mucker Teeth**.

Before you head up **Muckerhorn**... {break} ...those Cobbled Muckling can give you a real chomp! {break} If you need to **regain your health** after clobbering one or two of 'em, come stand by this **Campfire** next to me.
Collect {count}/{countTarget} Mucker Teeth from Cobbled Mucklings
Did you get all 6 of those teeth already?
Aye! These are perfect! {break} Here, choose one of these... they should make handling those muckers a bit easier.

At this point, your bags are probably overflowing with building and crafting materials. {break} Have a chat with **Lauriel**... {break} They spend a lot of time mining in the heart of Muckerhorn and can probably share a few ways to **increase your storage**.

Storage!? {break} You've come to the right place! {break} My mining partner Lawto has a brilliant recipe for a **Small Chest** that should save you some space. {break} Unfortunately, that **recipe** is at the end of this mine...
Tell Lawto that Lauriel sent you
Where did you come from!? {break} Ah! **Lauriel** sent you? Welcome! {break} You're looking for a **Small Chest Recipe**? {break} Well, look no further!
Tell Lawto that Lauriel sent you

Craft a few of those **Small Chests** on your land and you should be able to stockpile enough resources to last another **Muckergeddon**! {break} And here's a little something extra for whatever Muck-fighting machinery you're after!
Craft a Small Chest at your Workbench
Place the Small Chest at your home

Aaaa! A **Small Chest**! We've needed some storage around here. {break} Actually, I've received a transmission with a few extra materials and need to lighten my cargo... {break} Can you take one of these off of me? You can store them or continue building our home with them.

items.name: Blazing Trails
trigger: I'm really close to gettin' everything I need to make that Thermolite. Once I'm done, I'll share my schematic with ya. But, I'm afraid I still need some help gatherin' a few materials. The thing is, I'm not sure where to get the other materials. {break} I think I can handle what I need out of this cave, but maybe you could help me gather these other materials. {break} If you could lend a hand and help me gather the materials I need, I'd be much obliged.
Brilliant work, mate! With these materials, I can finally finish my Thermolite schematic.

With this baby, we'll be able to miniaturize our Thermoblasters and make 'em even more accessible. I can't wait to try it out. {break} Thanks to you, mate, we were able to get everything we needed. And now, you can even make cleansing flares at your own base, using the recipe I've shared with ya. {break} It's been a pleasure workin' with ya, mate. Remember that you can warp out using the photo here.

Well, look who's back! Thanks to you, Luis was able to get out of there with his new Thermolite designs! {break} The Collective is already buzzing the Thermolite, and rumor is that you have one at your robot. People are gonna be lookin' to me for crafting materials with it, that's for sure. {break}
But none of that would be possible without you, mate. You really came through for us, and for that, I'm truly grateful. If there's anything else I can help you with, just let me know.

{break} There's a lot you can learn from these folks so definitely spend some time getting to know them.

items.name: Picky Eater: Albert
trigger: I don't want to take up any more of your time... but... *sob* {break} Albert was one of my other cats that escaped. {break} Could you ever find and feed them for me!?
What are you doing up here little Meow? {break} I'll get you a nice **Spikefish** to snack on.

Catch a Spikefish in the muck to feed Albert
You found **Albert**? {break} How can I ever repay you??
My other cat who ran away only eats fish you can catch with a **Chrome Rod**, so please come back and help once you have one!

items.name: Irrational
trigger: Well there ya have it! That's why you always write down where you store your extra rations! {break} I stockpiled a few snacks and supplies for a rainy day and I cannot remember which cabin I put them in! {break} It must be a sign that I should just let 'em go! {break} I haven't the slightest where I hid them, but if you **find my camping supplies** in one of these cabins consider them yours!

items.name: Silver Platter
trigger: Taye here... miner, builder, silver pick wielder. {break} If yer interested in joining our ranks, mine some **Silver Nuggets** from the ores ye'll find in caves and underground. Bring them to me and I can show ye how to upgrade yer tools.
Bring the Silver Nuggets to Taye

Aye, {username}! Ye made it! {break} I can tell by all the rubble on yer mug that ye must have succesfully pick'd up those **Silver Nuggets!** {break} As ye know by now it's easier to avoid those muckers when yer underground but that doesn't mean yer alone down there... {break} I'm sure yer askin' yerself what these **Silver Nuggets** are for? {break} This should answer yer question...

By now ye may know that harder and rarer ores require harder and rarer tools to mine them. {break} If ye craft yerself one of those **Silver Picks** ye should be able to swing away at some of that sweet, sweet **gold** ye can find where the sun don't shine. {break} I'm working on something that should make the life of a builder much easier but I'm not ready to share yet. {break} If ye can bring me some **Gold Bars** and the teeth of a *Juggermucker** I can give ye one of my experimental models.
What have ye got for me?
Give Gold and Teeth to Taye

This was no easy task, ye'v impressed me {username}. {break} The work of the can feel purely ornamental at times... {break} ...but the true builder understands form and function. {break} To me, one of the most important things we can do to get back to where things were before the Muckergeddon is to create objects, structures, cities, and experiences. {break} We've been fighting for so long now, people have forgotten how to just live... {break} On that note, it's time for me to deliver on my end of the bargain... {break} Take this **Architect's Necklace**. It should help ye build a structure, city, or experience, that brings joy to others in this world.

trigger: I'm working on a few recipes for **light-emitting** seeds but I need a few flowers for my experiments. Please bring **Lilacs**, **Azaleas**, and **Dandelions** to me and let's figure out how to grow these things!
Head to Millie with the requested flowers
I wasn't sure you'd answer my request, {username}! {break} Were you able to bring those flowers?
Thank you! Before I regale you with my farming tales, take this for the flowers...

Before the Muckergeddon I worked at a nursery tending to flowers and small plants. {break} It quickly became clear to me the power these living, breathing things had. {break} Once the Muckers came and wiped out almost everything we had I made it my goal to re-populate the world with what I loved most... flowers. {break} Whatever the Muckers did to the soil stunted the growth of seeds but a few friends in Feuille and I have developed a **Seed Mill**... {break} The **Seed Mill** allows us to create seeds from flowers, plants, and trees! {break} Here is a **recipe for the blueprint**, you'll need this...
Collect Recipe for Blueprint: Seed Mill

And for those **light-emitting** plants I mentioned... {break} I've noticed that I can mix some rather peculiar ingredients in with some of the seeds and get some very interesting results... {break} I'll keep at it over here but go build your **Seed Mill** and start experimenting yourself!

You did it! These are brilliant! {break} You've proven yourself to be quite the farmer, we need more people like you around if we're going to get this world's plant life back to what it once was... {break} Here, take this... some extra storage to keep your flowers and crops all in one place!

Goodbye for now! {break} I don't want to go spreading rumors but I'll send you off with this... {break} My guess is that planting an Ultra Violet next to another type of flower may result in **some mysterious new seeds**...

items.name: The Depths of Fishing
trigger: Before we proceed, I would like to thank you for visiting me today. It means a lot to me that you've taken the time to come and discuss this with me. {break} Your expertise as a fisherman and your knowledge of the local area is highly valued, and I'm confident that we can work together to find the rare fish that I'm searching for. {break} As I mentioned earlier, the task at hand is to locate fish of rare colors that can only be found in the depths of caves.  {break} However, the information that I have been able to gather is limited, and I'm not entirely sure where these caves are located. {break} I do know, however, that some fish **prefer muck** and some **do not like muck**, but they **all live in caves**. {break} I believe you can find caves with water more easily by **finding a river**, followed by looking for a **cave that the water runs into**. {break} (Or, you could try to make your own cave...) {break} That's where I'm hoping you can help me. I'm willing to compensate you for your time and effort, and I'm eager to show you my own collection of rare fish as well. {break} So, what do you say? Are you willing to help me with this endeavor?
Welcome back, my friend! I see that you've been successful in your search, and I couldn't be more thrilled. Let's take a closer look at these fish, shall we?

Ah, the Skellegg! This fish is slightly **bioluminescent**, which is incredibly rare. I can hardly believe my luck in finding such a specimen. With further examination, I believe that we can learn a great deal from this fish. I'll only take one for my collection; you can keep the rest.

And the Swisher! This is a rare fish that I've been looking for. And look here, it seems that the Swisher can act as a mucker ward. This is fascinating! I'll need to do more research on this, but I believe that this could have some significant implications for the field of marine biology. {break} Since you're in close contact with Muck Researchers, I'll take one and leave you with the rest.

Once again, I want to thank you for your help in this matter. Your expertise and knowledge were invaluable in locating these fish, and I'm grateful for your efforts. {break} I hope that you found this experience to be as rewarding as I did. If you're interested, I'd be happy to show you some more of my rare fish collection and discuss any other interests you may have.

There is one fish that I didn't mention earlier, but it's a fish that I've been secretly hoping you would find. It's called the Dankwater Gunkus, and it's a legendary fish that is said to have mystical powers. {break} Of course, I didn't want to get your hopes up by mentioning this fish earlier, as it's an incredibly rare and difficult fish to catch, but if you were to come across one in your travels, I wouldn't mind examining a specimen.

trigger: {username}! There you are! {break} We just got a message from **Murray** at The Grove. {break} They've been serving coffee to the workers but are running dangerously low on supply. {break} Sadly, after the whole Mucker mess, our coffee bean farms got almost completely wiped out. {break} Thankfully our researchers are working hard on bringing back coffee into the world through a process called...

trigger: Pleasure, {username}. I'm Morella, grandchild of Mariana Stoke. {break} Mariana Stoke was one of the most famous chefs to ever walk this land. {break} Before the Muckening, they cooked decadent meals for the elites and provided free food for the needy. {break} When the Muckers first came, Mariana started working on **six secret recipes** that would help nourish those fighting back against the Muck. {break} Unfortunately, those recipes never were finished. {break} The only help I can give you is this... {break} After the Muckers first arrived, Mariana started using their meat for different types of sandwiches. {break} One day, she presented me with a **Muckerburger**. trigger: **Transmission from Chris at Brickleberry Farms** {break} {username}! {break} Chris here from Brickleberry Farms. {break} My old friend **Budd Sower** told me that you showed some interest in helping us re-introduce all the plant life we lost after the Muckergeddon. {break} If that's still the case, come find me at Brickleberry Farms, we could use your help!

{username}, you made it! {break} After the Muckening, us farmers have been working around the clock to provide food and building materials for the other survivors. {break} We quickly learned that if farmers, fishers, cooks, tailors, and builders weren't all helping each other out we'd be Mucker feed by now. {break} Speaking of... {break} I used to farm directly for a chef named Asio who made this delicious **Carrot Soup**. {break} I still don't know how Asio made it but I swear it helped me keep farming after the sun went down. {break} It might be a fools errand, but grow some carrots with these **Carrot Seeds** then see if you can find Asio.
Deliver the Carrots to Asio in Stoke
A delivery? What do ya got?

Fresh **Carrots**!? I haven't seen Carrots like this since... wait a minute... {break} Chris? Chris Cross? They survived!? They used to grow the most delicious produce I've ever tasted. {break} Chris used to say that my **Carrot Soup** could help him tend to his farm even in the dead of night. {break} I can show you how to make the **Carrot Soup** but understand, I'm not one of those scientific chefs. Ya know, hit a button and a dish pops out. {break} Chefs who truly love the **Kitchen** leave their recipe books behind and cook through feel, discovery, and soul! {break} As you can imagine, I retired my recipe book long ago. You're in luck though, I recently found my old **notes** for this exact Carrot Soup in some rubble. {break} Take these **notes** and a few of your **Carrots** back and see what you can do at my **Kitchen**!
Carrot Soup? I'll give it a shot

Let Asio know how the Carrot Soup turned out

I couldn't have made that **Carrot Soup** better myself! I always wondered how it'd taste with Roasted Carrots... {break} If it were up to me, I'd hand you a **Chef's Jacket** right now and get you helping out down here but I understand that the chef life is not for everyone. {break} If you want to continue learning about what we've got going down here, there's only one person you need to talk to and that's **Morella Stoke**. {break} Otherwise, here's a few extra warm bowls for your trip back. **Deliver one Carrot Soup to Chris** and tell them Asio says hi!
I'll go find Morella! Thank you

You found Asio? What did they say?

**slurp** **slurp** **slurp** {break} Ahhh! It tastes just like I remember! Have you tried one yet? {break} This **Carrot Soup** is your best friend when you're growing something that takes days and nights! {break} Thank you so much for this unexpected gift!
I also don't want you leaving without one of these!

One last thing... {break} I just rounded up a few extra **hay** from the barn over there and thought this could look nice back at your farm! {break} I know, I know, it won't clear the Muck, but it might be a nice little addition!
